# Ajay Sachdev
> Finance & Operations Manager at a B2B tech scale-up. CIMA finalist (Strategic Case Study sat May 2026). Builds production AI systems, Power BI dashboards, and financial models. Python, TypeScript, SQL. Based in Cambridge, UK.

## Background
- Sindhi family from Mumbai; grew up in the family textile business (est. 1988)
- Bachelor in Financial Markets, Jai Hind College, Mumbai (2015-18)
- M.Com (Year 1), University of Mumbai
- Diploma in Weaving Technology, Sasmira, Mumbai
- Chartered Wealth Management (AAFM, 2019)
- MSc Finance, Loughborough University (2020-21, 2:1)
- CIMA finalist: Strategic Case Study sat May 2026
- Joined a B2B tech scale-up in October 2021; now sole finance & ops function across UK, US, Pakistan
- School Governor at a 250-pupil primary school

## Projects
- OpsPilot: AI executive assistant in Microsoft Teams. 97,000 lines, 28 AI tools, 6,124+ documents indexed, 100% search accuracy on a 50-query suite. In production 24/7
- Trading Bot: FTSE 100 intraday system with four AI agents and an absolute-veto risk auditor. Paper trading: 62 sessions, zero impulsive trades let through
- Uni-Nation Digital (uni-nation.in): website, inventory PWA and Hindi voice stock entry for the family fabric business. Rs 13.76cr of sales data, 1,955 products, 658 customers
- WhatsApp Smart: Chrome extension prototype adding scheduling, AI replies and summaries to WhatsApp Web. 10 features built, privacy-first, unreleased
- SCS Cockpit: zero-dependency study engine built to prepare for his own CIMA case study. 4,200 lines

- Board-level financial models and reporting
